question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) KN-GI 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce3c04b324a9355c5d3e4bc9920cf8b300e8b43ae69e7f01492179e7d96b4894.png] 

Option 2) SV-OQ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40632b6db381c034f3050ae03731f4991ca93e7f946f39a72f69fb88c7f3271d.png] 

Option 3) OR-KM 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b94fbba37a29007771585cd850538eb7742f0fd7d8831bcffdda4da59f0a1b30.png] 

**Option 4) VY-RS **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6da6511973e0a9c0ea4bf80d52b54abaccb6adfe60bbed8f097fa82a6448a689.png]

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
